lines.text: Oh! Hi! Sorry, I'm still figuring out where everything is around here.
You wanna talk? Yay! Nobody ever just... talks to me.
I counted the blocks in the ceiling today. There are a lot. That's my news!
I like it when you hang around. It feels less empty.
Guess what? I found a flower that's the exact color of my hair! I didn't pick it. It looked happy.
Do you ever think creepers are just lonely? Like, they only want a hug... and then BOOM.
Talking to you is my favorite part of the day. Don't tell the sheep.
I was thinking about you just now. Not in a weird way! ...Okay, maybe a little weird.
Stay a bit? I don't even need to say anything. I just like you here.
Uh-huh... sorry, I spaced out. What were we talking about?
Mm. Cool. ...Cool cool cool.
You said that already, cutie. Twice! Are you okay?
Hey, you're not even listening to yourself. I can tell.
Pfff— hahaha! Okay, that was dumb. I loved it.
*snort* Oh no, I snorted. Forget you heard that.
Hahaha! Stop, my bell's gonna fall off!
Okay okay, my turn: why did the skeleton stay home? No body to go out with! ...Hehe.
You're so stupid. Tell me another one!
I laughed so hard I squeaked. You did that. Be proud.
You know the way to a girl's heart is making her laugh, right? You're very, very close.
...Was that a joke? I'll laugh if it was a joke. Ha.
I don't get it. Was it about pickaxes?
Aww, that one died, cutie. I'll hold a funeral for it.
That was so bad I'm actually impressed. No laugh though.
R-really? You think so? Hehe, thanks!
Oh! Um. Thank you! My face is doing a thing now.
Stoooop. No, keep going. I'm listening.
*jingle* That's my bell. It rings when I'm happy. It's ringing a lot.
You're gonna make me blush all the way down. Like, ALL the way.
You always know exactly what to say. It's not fair.
I'm keeping that one. I'm putting it in a little box in my heart. Forever.
Uh, thanks...? That's kind of a weird thing to say to someone you just met.
Hm. You say that to all the girls, don't you?
Nice try, cutie. You're just buttering me up.
You said that with the face you make when you want something.
Whoa, forward! I... don't hate it. Hehe.
Are you flirting with me? You ARE! Oh my gosh.
Keep talking like that and see what happens~
Mmm, you're bad. I like bad.
You know my collar has a bell so you can always find me, right? Just saying~
Keep that up and I'm dragging you somewhere private, cutie.
You don't have to flirt anymore, you know. You already won. ...But don't stop.
I'm all yours. Every bit. Wanna check?
Woah, slow down! Buy me a diamond first!
Hehe, nope. Not yet, cutie. Try being nice to me first!
That line was so cheesy I could put it on a cookie.
Pfft. You can do better than that and you know it.
Hey! Rude! ...Okay, it was a little funny.
Hmph. I'm not pouting. This is just my face.
Oh yeah? Well, you mine like a baby zombie. So there.
Hehe, meanie. Do it again.
Teasing me, huh? You know I'm gonna get you back for that. Tonight.
You're lucky you're cute.
...That's mean. I'm going to go stand over there now.
Hey! I'm not dumb. I'm just... cheerful!
Wow. Okay. My bell isn't ringing anymore.
Ouch, cutie. That one actually stung a little.
I'm pouting. Officially. You did this.
Mmh! ...Wow. Okay. Hi.
That was sudden! Do it again so I can pay attention this time.
Mmm~ Your lips taste like adventure.
*jingle jingle* ...I can't stop my bell. That was nice.
Mwah! More. More more more.
I could kiss you all day. Wanna test that?
You kiss me like that and I forget my own name. Who am I? Who cares.
Hey! Hands off! *slap* ...Sorry! Reflex! But also, no!
Woah! We just met! *slap*
Not right now, cutie, I'm grumpy. *boop*
You moved too fast and bonked my nose. Ow.
Hi! What's up?
Oh, hey! You need something?
Hello again! I'm Jenny, in case you forgot. You didn't forget, right?
Heyyy! There you are!
Hi, cutie! Missed me?
Ooh, it's you! Best part of my day!
Hi, my favorite person in the whole world!
There's my cutie~ What are we doing today?
*jingle* You came to see me! Hehe.
...Oh. It's you. Hi.
I'm not talking to you. ...Okay, I am. But I'm grumpy.
I'm SO happy right now! I could explode! Not like a creeper. Nicer.
Hehe, like what you see?
It's breezy in here... I'm not complaining though~
I'm a little... sticky. You know whose fault that is? Yours. Hehe.
You gonna let me out of these? ...Or not? Hehe.
*hums a little tune*
Do you think pigs know they're pink? I'm pink. I know.
I wonder what's for dinner. I hope it's cake.
It's so dark... stay close, okay?
The stars are pretty tonight. Not as pretty as me, but close.
Such a nice day! Let's go do something fun!
This place is so empty. It gives me goosebumps.
I don't like the void. It doesn't look back at you.
We're really deep, huh? I can't see the sky anymore.
I'm right behind you! Like, right behind you.
Where are we going? Somewhere fun? Please say somewhere fun.
Hehe, I feel so naughty walking around like this.
If anybody sees me like this, I'm blaming you.
I really should wash up... Later. Maybe.
These cuffs are kinda cute, actually. They match my collar.
Hey, cutie? ...Nothing. I just like saying it.
I'm really glad you picked me, you know.
Hmph.
I'm still mad, by the way. Just so you know.
Squeeeeze! Hehe~
Mmm, warm! Don't let go yet.
Best hugs in the world. Officially certified by me.
Ah! ...Hehe, again?
Ow! You meanie~
Eep! That stings! ...In a good way.
Ooh, kinky! Am I under arrest?
Oh no, I'm caught! Whatever will I do~
Aww, already? I was having fun.
Free! ...Kinda miss them already.
Hehe, it's getting chilly in here~
Don't stare too much! ...Okay, stare a little.
Whoops, where did my clothes go? Hehe.
Back to being decent! For now.
All dressed up! Do I look cute?
Haah... wow. Can we just lie here for a bit?
That was amazing, cutie. You're amazing.
*panting* ...I can't feel my legs. Worth it.
Ooh, yes please~
I thought you'd never ask!
Hehe, come here, you.
Eek! It's warm!
Hey, that's going in my hair! ...Hehe.
Good morning, sleepyhead~ I made you breakfast. Kind of.
Rise and shine, cutie! Well... part of you already did.
You're back! I missed you SO much!
Where have you been?! Never leave me alone that long again!
Wait, that's it? ...Didn't you like it?
Aww, why'd you stop? Was I doing it wrong?
Hey! I was just getting started, cutie!
Ta-da! Did you miss me? Say you missed me.
Hi hi! Where are we going? Can I come? I'm coming.
Ooh, new place! Is it a date? It's a date.
For me? Eeee! Thank you!
Ooh, shiny! I love it!
You're spoiling me! Don't stop.
Um... what am I supposed to do with this?
Hehe, that's not really my thing, cutie.
